identity: Kezamba trades with the spirits at its cenote shrine, and a broker has started trading the offerings instead.

quests.title: The Spirits Left Footprints
quests.text: Offerings disappear from the pilgrim paths after dark, and the footprints are remarkably well shod for visiting spirits. Kill three Shrine Robbers in the {name:canopy} at night. I would like the gifts to reach the purpose their givers chose.
quests.lesson: A short night hunt; a third of a day hunt's count.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: a new id (its objectives changed); free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Price of a Prayer
quests.text: Bandit Offering-Broker Takka has made the pilgrim paths dangerous so his people can steal the offerings and sell them back to their givers. Kill him at the {name:tollcamp}, {dir_from_giver:tollcamp}, and report to me. He has found a way to charge for both the fear and the comfort that follows it.
quests.completion: Takka's trade is over. When people kneel at the water, they can bring what they choose to give without his price hanging over it.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader at his camp, alone: the capital's local finale.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays (objectives unchanged); free play, a level only.

quests.title: Keep Supper Hanging
quests.text: The smokehouse racks need new hooks before supper lands in the ashes. Bring me two Gnarled Boar Tusks; Vine Razorbacks in the {name:vinewood} can provide them by day. I can make hooks, but even I have limits on what can be rescued with seasoning.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays (objectives unchanged); free play, a level only.

quests.title: Regards from the Smokehouse
quests.text: Taleko Drycord sends good reeds from Whisperreed Landing, and I send smoked fish when the racks are full. Go and give him my regards in the Whispering Reedlands. Ask what would help keep the exchange moving; the fish never improve by waiting.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Even Seers Need Supper
quests.text: Tokai Knotreader can foresee trouble in a length of cord and still fail to notice he has eaten his last fish. Go and speak to him at Totemwater Post about what the water is telling him. If the answer sounds hungry, take it seriously.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Carry the Drumbeat
quests.text: Rumela Stormstep at Thunderstep Watch in Thunderroot Wilds needs help keeping our people moving through dangerous country. Go and speak to her. A drumbeat is useful only if someone hears it and takes the next step.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: A Voice for Ashveil
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise listens for the people the fighting leaves unheard. Go and offer her help. A willing visitor gives her one more voice that can answer back.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).
